title: Shimokitazawa vs Golden Gai: Which Tokyo Neighborhood Should You Visit?
verdict: Shimokitazawa for daytime culture, vintage shopping, and live music. Golden Gai for late-night bar atmosphere. Do both in a single day — they're 15 minutes apart.

categories.name: Shopping
categories.summary: Shimokitazawa has 20+ vintage/thrift shops. Golden Gai has none.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: 200 tiny themed bars in 6 alleyways — nothing else in Tokyo compares.

categories.name: Live Music
categories.summary: Tokyo's undisputed live music capital with dozens of live houses.

categories.name: Food
categories.summary: Excellent independent dining. Golden Gai is drinks-only.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Slightly cheaper; Golden Gai cover charges add ¥500-1,500 per bar.

categories.name: Solo Travel
categories.summary: Tiny bar format forces conversation with strangers.

categories.name: Tourist-friendly
categories.summary: Easy to navigate any day. Golden Gai packed on weekends.

faq.question: Is Shimokitazawa or Golden Gai better for tourists?
faq.answer: Shimokitazawa is easier and more immediately enjoyable. Golden Gai rewards weeknight solo visitors.

faq.question: Can you do both Shimokitazawa and Golden Gai in one day?
faq.answer: Yes — afternoon in Shimokitazawa, evening in Golden Gai. 15 minutes apart by Odakyu Line.
